source: Dollar Bill: trade blotter, week of October 19
author: dollar-bill
text:
Trade blotter, week of October 19

- Bought 25,000 shares of Halcyon Airlines at $18.40 on October 20.
- Put a stop-loss on Halcyon Airlines at $16.50.
- Sold all 40,000 shares of Redwood Retail at $63.10 on October 22, about $310,000 above what we paid.
- Buy more Halcyon if it dips under $17.
